listing.name: Emergency Escape System
listing.summary: adds in a single hullmod that lets ships flee combat if destroyed (like the Phase Anchor)
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hullmod allowing ships to escape destruction by fleeing combat, with configurable limits on how many ships can use it.

description: Adds a single hullmod that lets ships flee combat if destroyed, similar to the Phase Anchor. Includes LunaSettings to configure the maximum number of ships this hullmod can allow to escape, with a default limit of one.
